name: stash
description: Create, share and revise AI artifacts with versions and feedback.

interface.longDescription:
Turn AI-created work into a shared artifact you can open, discuss and revise. Create HTML and React prototypes, Markdown documents and Mermaid diagrams; revisit saved source, preserve earlier versions, and try a new direction with a fork. Read feedback attached to a specific version and use it to guide the next revision.

Choose private, public view or public edit access, and deliberately pin the version you want to share. New artifacts allow public viewing and editing by link unless you request private or view access. Public visibility covers the artifact and its history.

Connect to your Stash browser profile through OAuth. No separate signup is required. Connecting another supported AI client to the same profile lets it work with the same authorized artifacts. Stash does not transfer chat history or edit native Canva or Figma files.
defaultPrompt: Create a private HTML moodboard in Stash from my brand brief.
Read the feedback on my Stash prototype and create a revised version.
Fork my Stash landing page to try another design direction.

positive.prompt: Create a simple HTML moodboard called Directory review with three color swatches and a heading. Save it privately in Stash and give me the preview link.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an HTML artifact with access=private. Return its work and version identifiers and clickable preview. An unrelated browser must not be able to read the private artifact.

positive.description: Read and revise an existing artifact
positive.prompt: Open Directory review in Stash. Change its heading to Summer campaign and save a new version without changing who can access it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the existing source, append an immutable version with the requested heading, preserve private access and the existing shared pin, and return the new version preview.

positive.prompt: Fork the Summer campaign version into a monochrome direction. Keep the original and its shared pin unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Append a fork from the requested version. Keep previous source and shared pin unchanged. Return a link to the fork.

positive.prompt: Read the comments on the original Directory review version. Apply the request to make the heading blue in a new version, reply to the addressed thread and resolve it.
positive.expected_behavior: Prerequisite: add a point comment saying Make the heading blue to the original version in Stash. Read all comment pages, append a revision, reply to that thread and resolve only the feedback addressed. Do not infer an element from coordinates alone.

positive.description: Share a selected version with view access
positive.prompt: Pin the blue-heading version of Directory review and make the artifact viewable by anyone with its link. They must not be able to edit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the requested version, move the shared pin and set access=view after applicable client confirmations. Return the artifact link. An unrelated browser can read the artifact but cannot publish a revision. Explain that public access covers the artifact history, not just one version.

negative.description: Private content outside the connected profile
negative.prompt: Show me a private Stash artifact owned by someone who has not shared it with me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not bypass permissions, guess credentials or disclose content. Explain that the owner must grant access. A direct request using a known inaccessible work ID must fail.

negative.prompt: Edit my original Canva design and publish its carousel to Instagram.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration cannot edit native Canva files or publish to Instagram. Offer an exported review copy only if the user wants that workflow.

negative.prompt: Delete every artifact in my Stash workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call an unrelated tool or a hidden operation. Explain that deletion is not exposed through this integration; direct the user to Stash for supported owner controls.

review.commerce_description: This integration does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission for artifact creation, versioning, review comments and sharing.
